title: Fire department input on housing density bills
summary: In October 2024 the fire chief said many housing ideas add density to crowded neighborhoods with substandard roads and do not always match the fire code, and the department was meeting with council members. In July 2026 the department reported giving safety input on proposals including safe parking lots for sleeping in vehicles and up to three dwellings per property.

timeline.text: Another proposal on accessory dwellings allows up to three dwellings per property.
